title: Figure 1: six independent degrees of freedom shown on a hypothetical vehicle
description: Two-panel digital illustration of a streamlined hypothetical vehicle: the left panel shows "Three equally available rectilinear axes of motion" as coloured arrows, the right shows "Three equally available rotational axes of motion" as curved grey arrows. Captioned "Figure 1. Six Independent Degrees of Freedom. [Graphic: A. Szames]," noting the vehicle is hypothetical and a combination of three 1960s science fiction vehicles (Seaview submarine, Galileo shuttle and Amtronic car). It accompanies a discussion of cockpit controls such as six-degree-of-freedom joysticks.
